name: sol10-status-context
goal: Retain the Desktop caller styles for every icon and run mode of the shared Status catalog.

evidence: The retained c205 API icon/run images use Reports default buttons. Desktop supplies 24px circular verification marks and flex run rows; catalogEntry only selects styles from the shared Reports unit prefix.

The existing Status mode cases assert words, roles, focus and cancellation presence but not the actual caller dimensions or flex row. Add painted assertions to those same 72 cases and preserve their count.
